title: Current August 21 child-endangerment indictments against four Siders adults

data.claim: The August 21 grand-jury indictment structure is 19 child-endangerment counts each for Gary Siders Jr., Elizabeth Siders, and Christina Siders, and 16 counts for Gary Siders Sr.; some counts are charged in the alternative.
data.adjudication: pending-adjudication; indictment is an allegation, not a conviction
